verdict.rationale: Semgrep documents an official MCP server enabling AI agents/LLMs to invoke scans via natural-language-driven tool calls, and Semgrep Assistant adds AI-based finding triage, but a hands-on probe found the MCP server failed its stdio handshake ('Semgrep is not installed or not in your PATH') despite a working local install, and a community report notes an LLM hallucinating nonexistent Semgrep functions.
